principle: Only point-in-time reproducible information may enter certifiable Model_P features.

CFBD_RAW_GAMES_PLAYS_ADVANCED.condition: The query/window must end strictly before the target game and the raw/cache artifact must be retained.

CFBD_SP_PLUS.condition: Use only a prior-season value as a preseason prior unless an immutable historical PIT snapshot proves the exact in-season value was available then.

CFBD_CORE.condition: Historical retrospective CORE results are not certification-grade PIT inputs unless SportsEdge previously archived the exact live snapshot/modelVersion at the relevant as-of time.

FPI_OR_EXTERNAL_RATINGS.condition: Blocked from certification unless the exact historical PIT snapshot, source methodology/version and timestamp are archived.

RETURNING_PRODUCTION_TALENT_PORTAL_QB_CO.condition: Each value must come from an approved, versioned PIT provider or a logged Manual/Hybrid source artifact. Missing values fail closed for feature contracts that require them.

PUBLIC_BETTING_OR_MARKET_DATA.condition: Market context only. Never a predictive Model_P feature or Truth Gate certification feature.
